integrity: The infinite character formula is proved by signed fixed-orbit enumeration and a fixed transfer matrix; finite checks confirm but do not replace that proof. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The homotopy concentration of these complexes is a prior theorem; the new claim is the full natural rational dihedral representation and rational quotient homology. Integral representation lattices, equivariant homotopy types and definitive publication priority are not established.
title: Complete dihedral homology representations of cyclic three-path-devoid complexes
